title: 第1576章 剑拔弩张温雅求饶第1575章 直面北君针锋相对
slug: 自缚禁地五百年我当散修你哭啥
content_zh:
顾修的话说得极为果断，完全没有留下半点转圜的余地。
他知道对方对碎星有仇，也知道对方提起碎星，必然会将碎星当成要求。
所以，顾修放弃了和对方浪费口水的功夫。
直接把路堵死。
这么做确实能省很多力气，但同样的，也让话都到嗓子眼的北君，面色难看了起来。
“咚！”
北君重重把茶杯放在桌上，目光阴寒到没有半点温情：“顾皇难道不想听听我的条件？”
“没必要。”
顾修摇头，自顾自的再次喝了一口茶。
“若我告诉你，你若是把岁叙初交给我发落，我可宣誓带领整个凛冬城效忠于你，至死方休呢？”
顾修笑了笑，笑容有些轻蔑：“就这？”
“凛冬城比你想象的要更加强大，我的效忠，也远比你想象的，要更加重要。”
北君开口：
“相信我，我能够带给你的，不单单只是一座城池的效忠那么简单，而是你能在未来和孽妖寂尊大决战时，增加一项不弱的筹码。”
“而你要付出的，仅仅只是把一件法宝交给我而已。”
“你如今身为三垣人皇，为了三垣人族，牺牲一件法宝而已，这笔买卖很划算。”
“我不这么觉得。”
顾修摇头，直接拒绝：
“我想我有必要提醒阁下一句，顾某愿意为三垣人族出一些力，是因为我看得见的人，而不是什么人族大义之类的东西。”
“所以，若是为了所谓的大义，就要放弃我自己的手足兄弟，那顾某情愿这所谓的大义就此止步。”

说到这，顾修起身，脸上的笑容已经彻底消失，化作不弱于北君的冰寒：“这话，顾某只会说这一次，所以还希望北君，不要浪费彼此时间。”
北君明显也不是什么好脾气，噌的站了起来：“你一个七阶修士，现在还在我凛冬城内，你当真要冥顽不灵？”
顾修没有回答，只是随手一挥。
渡仙剑顷刻入手。
他没有开口争取什么，只是用行动表明了自己的态度。
要战便战！
顾某，接下便是！
这一刻，大殿内的气氛压抑到了极致，双方剑拔弩张，随时都有可能大打出手。
“参……参见北君！”
凝重的气氛，最终还是被人打破。
来人不是别人，正是之前追了顾修他们一路，但却始终无法追上战舰的温大人一行人。
他们看样子是拼了老命赶来的，身上气息混乱，额头都带着汗水，但偏偏他们不敢有丝毫造次，甚至连大气都不敢喘一口。
有这几人的闯入，倒是打断了方才僵持的局面。
北君收回盯着顾修的目光，转头看向下首的女子：
content_en:
Gu Xiu's words were extremely decisive, leaving absolutely no room for change.
He knew that the other party had a grudge against Broken Star, and he also knew that when the other party mentioned Broken Star, he would definitely regard Broken Star as a request.
Therefore, Gu Xiu gave up wasting words with the other party.
Just block the road.
Doing this can indeed save a lot of energy, but it also makes Beijun, whose words are stuck in his throat, look ugly.
"Boom!"
Beijun placed the tea cup heavily on the table, his eyes so cold that there was no warmth at all: "Don't you want Emperor Gu to hear my terms?"
"No need."
Gu Xiu shook his head and took another sip of tea.
"What if I told you that if you leave Sui Xuchu to me, I can swear to lead the entire Winter City to be loyal to you until death?"
Gu Xiu smiled, a bit disdainfully: "That's it?"
"Winter City is more powerful than you think, and my loyalty is far more important than you think."
Beijun spoke:
"Believe me, what I can bring to you is not just the loyalty of a city, but also a powerful bargaining chip for you in the future decisive battle with the evil demon Jizun."
"And all you have to pay is to hand over a magic weapon to me."
"As the emperor of Sanyuan people now, you only sacrificed a magic weapon for the sake of the Sanyuan people. This deal is a good deal."
"I don't think so."
Gu Xiu shook his head and refused directly:
"I think I need to remind you that Gu is willing to do something for the Sanyuan Human Race because he is a person I can see, not because of the righteousness of the human race."
"So, if I have to give up my own brothers for the so-called righteousness, then Gu would rather the so-called righteousness stop here."
Having said this, Gu Xiu stood up, and the smile on his face had completely disappeared, turning into a cold expression that was no weaker than Bei Jun: "Gu will only say this once, so I hope Bei Jun will not waste our time."
Beijun obviously didn't have a good temper, and stood up in confusion: "You are a seventh-level monk, and you are still in my Winter City. Are you really going to be stubborn?"
Gu Xiu didn't answer, just waved his hand.
Get the Immortal Crossing Sword instantly.
He didn't fight for anything with his mouth, but showed his attitude with actions.
If you want to fight, fight!
Gu, take that next step!
At this moment, the atmosphere in the hall was extremely oppressive. The two sides were at war with each other and could fight at any time.
"See...see Beijun!"
The solemn atmosphere was finally broken.
The person who came was none other than Mr. Wen and his party, who had chased Gu Xiu and the others all the way before, but had never been able to catch up with the battleship.
They looked like they had worked hard to get here, their aura was chaotic, and there was sweat on their foreheads, but they didn't dare to make any mistakes, and they didn't even dare to take a breath.
The intrusion of these people broke the stalemate just now.
Beijun retracted his gaze from Gu Xiu and turned to look at the woman looking down:
